notes: A pipe run's length now shows just once, above the pipe, and nothing underneath. A run that isn't joined on gets its own length; the other straights' lengths show only with Segments ticked, above the pipe too. The PDF for Bluebeam now draws counts and pipes at the same size as the app. File > Export PDF for Bluebeam… asks where to save (a folder when there are several drawings) and remembers the last place.
